meta.name: do
meta.description: Execute a phased implementation plan using subagents. Use when asked to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用子智能体自动执行分阶段计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有分步计划需要自动执行
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a step-by-step plan to execute automatically

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会充当“总指挥”：把待执行的分阶段计划细化成子任务，派给专用子代理完成，自己只做协调、核对与验证结果。每一步完成要求子代理报告证据，验证通过前不推进、不提交。
howto.when: 当用户要求执行、运行或实施某个计划时触发，尤其是由 make-plan 生成的分阶段计划。

say.text: 请执行这份分阶段计划。
say.note: Claude 会作为总指挥按阶段派子代理推进。

say.text: 按计划执行，每一步验证通过后再提交。
say.note: 每个阶段后都会派验证子代理，确保通过才继续。

say.text: 帮我运行 make-plan 生成的计划。
say.note: 这是此技能的典型入口，走完整分阶段流程。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes an orchestrator: subagents perform the implementation work. Claude coordinates context, verifies that each phase matches its checklist, requires evidence from subagents, and does not advance or commit until verification passes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially a phased plan created by make-plan.

say_en.note: Claude acts as orchestrator and deploys subagents per phase.

say_en.text: Run the plan and verify each step before committing.
say_en.note: A verification subagent runs after each phase before moving on.

say_en.text: Run the plan generated by make-plan.
say_en.note: Typical entry point; uses the full phased workflow.
